name: Barbarian: Outrage is extended by critical hits on training dummies (#12836)
contract: Outrage 801759 lasts 10 seconds; each critical physical hit extends it by "Outrage - Increase Duration" 560016
(1000 ms) up to 20 seconds in total with Bloodthirsty 300497, which doubles the step to 2000 ms (#7605).
npc_training_dummy (32666) sets the damage it takes to 0 in DamageTaken, and the Outrage proc check required
damage above 0, so crits on a training dummy never extended Outrage (#12836). One Whirling Advance that critically
hits five training dummies grants five 2000 ms extensions: the full 10-second budget, against none before the fix.
